answer.narration:
You tap the listing. A minute later a woman calls the hall screen back: mid-thirties, headset, a dock bay full of noise behind her.

"Juno Reyes, Reyes Rapid. My pilot quit an hour ago." She squints at your license scan. "Licensed, young, cheap. Good. A sealed medical crate to the mining hab at Occator Ridge. Fast skiff, nasty terrain, the landing pad's half a ledge. Three hundred cash on landing."

She sees you hesitate. "It's real medicine, kid. Customs already scanned it. I saw where you're calling from."

Then she adds, "Fly it clean and I've got steadier work. Real money for a pilot who doesn't crash my skiffs."

Bay Nine. She wants an answer now.
choices: Take the job, head to Bay Nine
Ask for half the pay upfront
Ask about the steadier work first
answer.summary: Waren Spacefarer, a young pilot with ten credits, wants forty thousand to buy Marta Okafor's Kestrel. His relief pilot job on Dren Vasko's tug Grubstake turned out to be people smuggling. He alerted customs, disabled the drive, got Vasko to surrender and freed eleven refugees. He gave Inspector Hale an honest statement, filed an informant fund claim (payout months away) and had his cracked ribs strapped. The Vesta job is probably lost. Juno Reyes of Reyes Rapid offers him a three-hundred-credit courier run with medical cargo to Occator Ridge, and hints at steadier, better-paid work afterwards.
